description: This Python source file defines an XMLParser class that extends the functionality of xml.etree.ElementTree.XMLParser to support XHTML DTDs and all Python-supported encodings. It includes methods for parsing XML data, handling external entities, and error management.

classes.name: XMLParser
classes.description: A custom XML parser supporting XHTML DTDs and multiple encodings, with methods for parsing, handling external entities, and error management.

methods.name: _wrap_error
methods.description: Wraps and raises an XML parsing error with additional context.

methods.name: _fixname
methods.description: Fixes XML tag or attribute names, handling namespace prefixes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the XMLParser with optional encoding, setting up the expat parser and callbacks.

methods.name: _xml_decl
methods.description: Handles XML declaration, capturing encoding information.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Handles start of an XML element, fixing tag names and attributes.

methods.name: _data
methods.description: Handles character data within XML elements.

methods.name: _end
methods.description: Handles end of an XML element.

methods.name: _external
methods.description: Handles external entity references, particularly XHTML DTDs.

methods.name: _skipped
methods.description: Handles skipped entities and raises appropriate errors.

methods.name: feed
methods.description: Feeds data into the parser, handling multi-byte encoding issues.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Finalizes parsing and returns the parsed XML tree.
